caption_L1: This bar diagram is labeled Major countries of destination for U.S. fresh fruit exports in 2018 (in 1,000 metric tons). There is a linear scale from 0 to 500 on the y-axis, marked Exports in thousand metric tons. On the x-axis, Country is measured.
caption_L2L3: The USA exports more fruit to Mexico than it does any other country. The least amount of fruit goes to the Dominican Republic. It exports most of its fruit to nearby countries Canada and Mexico. Most of the countries the US exports fresh fruit to are in Asia.
